children: Martin Marietta entered into the Eighteenth Amendment to its Credit and Security Agreement to extend the maturity of its $500 million trade receivables securitization facility to September 15, 2027. The facility, which can be increased to up to $700 million subject to lender commitments, will bear interest at Adjusted Term SOFR plus 0.700%. The amendment maintains liquidity and flexibility backed by trade receivables originated by Martin Marietta and certain subsidiaries.
: Amendment to trade receivables securitization facility
: Truist Bank, as administrative agent, and other lenders
